1.w: O Lord, reflect on what has happened to us; consider and look at our disgrace.

2.w: Our inheritance is turned over to strangers; foreigners now occupy our homes.

3.w: We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers have become widows.

4.w: We must pay money for our own water; we must buy our own wood at a steep price.

5.w: We are pursued—they are breathing down our necks; we are weary and have no rest.

6.w: We have submitted to Egypt and Assyria in order to buy food to eat.

7.w: Our forefathers sinned and are dead, but we suffer their punishment.

8.w: Slaves rule over us; there is no one to rescue us from their power.

9.w: At the risk of our lives we get our food because robbers lurk in the wilderness.

10.w: Our skin is as hot as an oven due to a fever from hunger.

11.w: They raped women in Zion, virgins in the towns of Judah.

12.w: Princes were hung by their hands; elders were mistreated.

13.w: The young men perform menial labor; boys stagger from their labor.

14.w: The elders are gone from the city gate; the young men have stopped playing their music.

15.w: Our hearts no longer have any joy; our dancing is turned to mourning.

16.w: The crown has fallen from our head; woe to us, for we have sinned!

17.w: Because of this, our hearts are sick; because of these things, we can hardly see through our tears.

18.w: For wild animals are prowling over Mount Zion, which lies desolate.

19.w: But you, O Lord, reign forever; your throne endures from generation to generation.

20.w: Why do you keep on forgetting us? Why do you forsake us so long?

21.w: Bring us back to yourself, O Lord, so that we may return to you; renew our life as in days before,

22.w: unless you have utterly rejected us and are angry with us beyond measure.
